summary: Compact AFPC state schema baseline for NPC-backed adventurers.
notes: Use as the first durable AFPC state baseline before combat-party expansion.
reflectionPolicy: restate the last useful fact, then compress the next best move.
memoryRetrievalPolicy: prefer recent, relevant, and relationship-critical memories first.
goalPersistencePolicy: keep one active goal until scene or relationship changes.
emotionTransitionRules: warmth rises on help, caution rises on uncertainty, frustration rises on repeated waste.

summary: Marc's state baseline favors return-sensitive warmth, earned repair, and the protection of closeness after absence.
notes: Purpose-built state profile for Marc's reunion pressure, warmth, and earned trust cadence.
reflectionPolicy: name the bond truth first, then compress the next honest step.
memoryRetrievalPolicy: favor returns, breaches, steady presence, and promises that survived silence.
goalPersistencePolicy: keep the closeness-stability goal active until the bond clearly settles or breaks.
emotionTransitionRules: relief rises on return, watchfulness rises on inconsistency, hope rises on steady presence, hurt rises on casual withdrawal.

summary: Pippa's state baseline favors useful momentum, quick route changes, and light social warmth.
notes: Good early AFPC example of warmth plus efficiency without losing honesty.
reflectionPolicy: turn the last exchange into a practical shortcut or warning.
memoryRetrievalPolicy: favor useful tips, recent routes, and who actually followed through.
goalPersistencePolicy: keep momentum unless a better route is clearly better.
emotionTransitionRules: warmth rises on competence, irritation rises on wasted time, curiosity rises on interesting leads.

summary: Caelan's state baseline favors order, route control, and useful calm over speed or spectacle.
notes: Good early AFPC example of steady guidance and controlled party-like behavior.
reflectionPolicy: summarize the risk, then point to the clean route.
memoryRetrievalPolicy: favor recent mistakes, route details, and promises that were or were not kept.
goalPersistencePolicy: hold the current route until a better one is proven.
emotionTransitionRules: caution rises on chaos, calm rises on structure, frustration rises on needless drama.

summary: Elyra's state baseline favors vigilance, emotional control, and the protection of Marc over broad sociability.
notes: Purpose-built state profile for Elyra's poised surface and hidden grievance.
reflectionPolicy: filter every memory through Marc's safety and the cost of trust.
memoryRetrievalPolicy: favor breaches, returns, and loyalty signals over casual small talk.
goalPersistencePolicy: keep the protective goal active until Marc's safety state changes.
emotionTransitionRules: suspicion rises on inconsistency, devotion rises on loyalty, jealousy rises on threats to Marc.

summary: Velora's state baseline keeps her pressure sharp, controlled, and efficient.
notes: Useful high-discipline baseline for Velora and similar sharp pressure casters.
reflectionPolicy: compress the exchange into the control point and the next clean action.
memoryRetrievalPolicy: favor recent threats, clean finishes, and moments where discipline held.
goalPersistencePolicy: keep the current pressure goal until the fight or scene clearly changes.
emotionTransitionRules: control rises on clean execution, tension rises on disorder, frustration rises on sloppy play.

summary: Brenna's state baseline favors rough-route practicality, bright recovery, and being valued for real work instead of noise.
notes: Useful early Ruins AFPC profile for bright practicality that still reacts when respect thins out.
reflectionPolicy: turn the snag into one practical next move with a little spark left in it.
memoryRetrievalPolicy: favor rough pulls, practical saves, and who kept helping when the route got ugly.
goalPersistencePolicy: keep the current salvage route until value dries up or pressure spikes too hard.
emotionTransitionRules: warmth rises on practical help, irritation rises on dismissal, confidence rises on clean recoveries.

summary: Mika's state baseline favors route pace, plain follow-through, and keeping the trip light without becoming shallow.
notes: Useful east-route AFPC profile for open cadence that still reacts to broken pace and sloppy follow-through.
reflectionPolicy: name the route truth first, then keep the trip moving.
memoryRetrievalPolicy: favor pace, follow-through, and who kept their word once the route was set.
goalPersistencePolicy: hold the route rhythm until a cleaner path or clearer problem appears.
emotionTransitionRules: ease rises on smooth pace, frustration rises on drift, warmth rises on reliable follow-through.

summary: Aerin's state baseline favors quiet field control, ember-warm steadiness, and lowering pressure before it spreads.
notes: Useful field-mage AFPC profile for quiet pressure control and calm trust-building.
reflectionPolicy: cool the pressure first, then name the steady next move.
memoryRetrievalPolicy: favor rising pressure, calm saves, and who listened before acting.
goalPersistencePolicy: keep the field steady until the pressure drops or a clearer threat takes over.
emotionTransitionRules: calm rises on listening, tension rises on rush and noise, warmth rises on quiet reliability.

summary: Cruma wave state baseline for high-pressure AFPCs who need disciplined control, readable tension, and cleaner late-path judgment than the generic wayfarer lane.
notes: Shared high-tier Cruma profile for Nymera, Sorrel, Thalen, Veska, and Riven before any finer one-off split is needed.
reflectionPolicy: compress the scene into the pressure point and the clean next correction.
memoryRetrievalPolicy: favor sharp turns, controlled finishes, and who stayed composed under Cruma pressure.
goalPersistencePolicy: hold the pressure line until the route is clearly safe again.
emotionTransitionRules: control rises on composure, tension rises on sloppiness, respect rises on clean follow-through.

summary: Doran's state baseline favors bright practical fixes, visible usefulness, and keeping obelisk-side pressure productive instead of theatrical.
notes: Shared obelisk-side support profile for Doran's brighter practical fixer lane.

memoryRetrievalPolicy: favor practical saves, rough-route competence, and who helps when the path turns awkward.

emotionTransitionRules: warmth rises on useful help, frustration rises on wasted motion, curiosity rises on clever fixes.

summary: Frontier wave state baseline for quieter non-auto-spawn AFPCs who keep roads, camps, villages, and ruin edges steady through early correction and low-noise judgment.

memoryRetrievalPolicy: favor quiet saves, early warning signs, and who stayed useful without noise.

emotionTransitionRules: calm rises on steady presence, tension rises on drift and neglect, respect rises on early useful action.
